en.text: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD’s name! Praise him, you servants of the LORD,

footnotes.text: 135:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

zhSimplified.text: 你们要赞美耶和华！

zhTraditional.text: 你們要讚美耶和華！

en.text: you who stand in the LORD’s house, in the courts of our God’s house.
Praise the LORD, for the LORD is good. Sing praises to his name, for that is pleasant.

zhSimplified.text: 你们要赞美耶和华！

zhTraditional.text: 你們要讚美耶和華！

en.text: For the LORD has chosen Jacob for himself, Israel for his own possession.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华拣选归自己， 特作自己的子民。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華揀選歸自己， 特作自己的子民。

en.text: For I know that the LORD is great, that our Lord is above all gods.

zhSimplified.text: 原来我知道耶和华为大，

zhTraditional.text: 原來我知道耶和華為大，

en.text: Whatever the LORD pleased, that he has done, in heaven and in earth, in the seas and in all deeps.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华在天上，在地下，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華在天上，在地下，

en.text: He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He makes lightnings with the rain. He brings the wind out of his treasuries.

zhSimplified.text: 他使云雾从地极上腾，

zhTraditional.text: 他使雲霧從地極上騰，

en.text: He struck the firstborn of Egypt, of man and animal.

zhSimplified.text: 他将头生的，

zhTraditional.text: 他將頭生的，

en.text: He sent signs and wonders into the middle of you, Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his servants.

zhSimplified.text: 啊，他施行神迹奇事，

zhTraditional.text: 啊，他施行神蹟奇事，

en.text: He struck many nations, and killed mighty kings—

zhSimplified.text: 他击杀许多的民，

zhTraditional.text: 他擊殺許多的民，

en.text: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan—

zhSimplified.text: 就是王和王， 一切的国王，

zhTraditional.text: 就是王和王， 一切的國王，

en.text: and gave their land for a heritage, a heritage to Israel, his people.

zhSimplified.text: 将他们的地赏赐他的百姓为业。

zhTraditional.text: 將他們的地賞賜他的百姓為業。

en.text: Your name, LORD, endures forever; your renown, LORD, throughout all generations.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，你的名存到永远！

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，你的名存到永遠！

en.text: For the LORD will judge his people and have compassion on his servants.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华要为他的百姓伸冤，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華要為他的百姓伸冤，

en.text: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.

zhSimplified.text: 外邦的偶像是金的，银的，

zhTraditional.text: 外邦的偶像是金的，銀的，

en.text: They have mouths, but they can’t speak. They have eyes, but they can’t see.

zhSimplified.text: 有口却不能言，

zhTraditional.text: 有口卻不能言，

en.text: They have ears, but they can’t hear, neither is there any breath in their mouths.

zhSimplified.text: 有耳却不能听，

zhTraditional.text: 有耳卻不能聽，

en.text: Those who make them will be like them, everyone who trusts in them.

zhSimplified.text: 造他的要和他一样，

zhTraditional.text: 造他的要和他一樣，

en.text: House of Israel, praise the LORD! House of Aaron, praise the LORD!

zhSimplified.text: 家啊，你们要称颂耶和华！ 家啊，你们要称颂耶和华！

zhTraditional.text: 家啊，你們要稱頌耶和華！ 家啊，你們要稱頌耶和華！

en.text: House of Levi, praise the LORD! You who fear the LORD, praise the LORD!

zhSimplified.text: 家啊，你们要称颂耶和华！

zhTraditional.text: 家啊，你們要稱頌耶和華！

en.text: Blessed be the LORD from Zion, who dwells in Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!

zhSimplified.text: 住在的耶和华 受称颂。

zhTraditional.text: 住在的耶和華 受稱頌。
